## Scope

- Determine the minimum automation justified for adoption checks.
- Avoid broad automation that increases maintenance without clear return.

## Acceptance criteria

- Recommendation includes cost/benefit and maintenance burden.
- Proposed automation is optional and incremental.
- No new mandatory automation without maintainer approval.
